title: DAAD Scholarship
reason: DAAD Scholarship (general) provides stipend EUR 992/mo + insurance + travel allowance + study allowance EUR 460/yr. NO tuition coverage (German public universities are tuition-free for most programmes). Not fully funded per ScholarZone definition (requires tuition + living).

title: ARES Scholarships (Belgium)
reason: ARES provides living allowance and travel but tuition coverage varies by programme. Funding scope not fully confirmed from official source.

title: Netherlands Fellowship Programme (NFP/OTS)
reason: Netherlands Fellowship Programme (NFP/OTS) discontinued. Replaced by NL Scholarship (EUR 5000 first year only, partial).

title: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship
reason: Vanier CGS discontinued after Fall 2024. Replaced by CGRS-D. Should be archived/discontinued.

title: Erasmus Mundus
reason: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters covers full tuition + EUR 1,400/mo stipend + travel + insurance. Fully funded.
